function.description:
Retrieves the count (number) of conditions defined for a specific rule (`ruleId`) within a rule-based compliance (RBC) policy (`policyId`). Use this when the user asks how many conditions a compliance/RBC rule checks. Resolve `policyId` with api_getCompliancePolicies and `ruleId` with api_getComplianceRules first.

Partial filters: this tool counts the conditions of ONE rule and has no filter beyond `policyId` and `ruleId`. If the user asks for a count narrowed by anything else, such as condition type or operator, return the count for the rule and say plainly which part of the request could not be applied because the count API has no parameter for it. If the user asks for a total across all rules or all policies, do not loop over them; explain that condition counts are reported per rule and offer the count for the rules they name. Never fabricate a filtered number and never approximate it by listing conditions and tallying them, because the list tool is paginated.
function.name: api_getComplianceConditionCount

ruleId.description: The `id` of the rule within the compliance policy.

responses.description: Reports a count, for example, a total count of records in a given resource.
responses.title: Count Response
